nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge (use AMBIGUOUS if unsure), never skip the corpus size warning, always show token cost, never hide cohesion scores, never run HTML viz on >5000 nodes without warning.

nodes.label: Part A: Structural (AST) Extraction
nodes.rationale: AST extraction is deterministic and free (no LLM, no API key). A code-only corpus skips semantic extraction entirely and needs nothing beyond this pass.

nodes.label: Part B: Semantic Extraction
nodes.rationale: Uses Gemini only if GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY is already set; otherwise the host agent itself is the LLM (dispatches subagents). graphify never reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY and must never block or prompt for a missing key.

nodes.label: Node ID Format Rule
nodes.rationale: IDs must be {full-repo-relative-path-stem}_{entity}, every directory level kept, deterministic from the label alone, matching the AST extractor's format exactly so semantic and AST nodes dedupe instead of creating orphan ghost duplicates.

nodes.label: Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: INFERRED edges must pick a discrete score from {0.95,0.85,0.75,0.65,0.55}, never 0.5, because models collapse continuous ranges into a bimodal 0.5/0.85+ split in production; discrete rubrics are followed more faithfully.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion (Step 0)
nodes.rationale: graphify's matcher is case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming/synonyms/cross-language matching, so a wording mismatch between the user's question and the graph's vocabulary collapses the answer to zero hits; queries must be expanded against the graph's own extracted vocabulary first, using only tokens that literally appear there.

nodes.label: Wake
nodes.rationale: Two distinct triggers for the same physical WoL action: deliberate (UI Wake button) and automatic (the Gateway API's /server* proxy route on any proxied request while Compute is asleep).

nodes.label: Suspend
nodes.rationale: Suspend-to-RAM is the only supported sleep state; full shutdown (ACPI S5) is explicitly out of scope because WoL after full power-off is unreliable across BIOS/NIC configurations.

nodes.label: Identity Header
nodes.rationale: The Tailscale-User-Login header injected by tailscale serve is the entire authentication mechanism for both apps; tailnet membership alone is the authorization boundary, with no separate allow-list.

nodes.label: Known Limitations (Flagged Transparency)
nodes.rationale: No cross-subnet WoL error path, reachabilityTracker can only observe becoming reachable, Grafana Cloud pipeline has no retry/buffering, bind-address enforcement is runtime-only -- documented explicitly rather than silently assumed away.

nodes.label: Known Gaps (Flagged, Not Silently Dropped)
nodes.rationale: Bind-address enforcement is not checked by pyinfra, and the server-side workload proxy /server* forwards to doesn't exist yet -- explicit, deferred gaps rather than implied completeness.

nodes.label: Deploys Are Manually Triggered Only
nodes.rationale: No CI/cron/hook triggers a deploy; an unattended deploy against a two-device personal setup is a risk not worth taking.
